patch_description: The best prior program (score 0.99) used seeded L-BFGS annealing on a soft-min/soft-max objective. The key recommendation was perturb-and-reanneal restarts around the incumbent: rather than only perturbing at trial initialization, re-perturb the best solution found so far and run full annealing chains again. I combine this with structured seeds from the context programs (the staggered double-hexagon D6 family with poles, the icosahedron+2 construction, and random sphere points), all funneled through a shared annealed soft-min/soft-max polish that works directly on d² (scale-invariant up to normalization). After the seeded trials, 10 perturb-reanneal restarts at 0.08 noise around the incumbent explore the basin around the best configuration — this is where prior gains plateau-breaking occurred. A final greedy targeted pair-move hill-climb squeezes out remaining numerical slack on the exact min/max pairs.
